Implicit: validating decodes and 50 copy loops (P7). No semantic error found.
summary: Faithful; all 23 loops present (nested EigenLayer loops shown as nested whiles), but abi.encodePacked appends are nested copy loops, calldata struct-array fields are raw nested offsets, and the limit-order loops are rotated as in c00474.
